# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**Short answer:** The JBL Live 780NC has the best noise cancelling in this price range, and the Soundcore Space One is the best value.

## Top picks

**Best noise cancelling: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS ranks it #1 under $200. Its ANC rivals Sony and Bose flagships, and it has 60 hours of battery plus LDAC and multipoint.
- The downside is high clamping force and thin headband padding, which can be uncomfortable on larger heads.
- RTINGS says it sometimes goes on sale "just below" $200, so check the current price. [RTINGS page with Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart price links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Soundcore Space One, $99.99 ($80 with code AFSC20)**
- It has 40 hours of battery with ANC on, LDAC (works on Android, not with multipoint), and a 3.5 mm input.
- SoundGuys measured about 43 hours of battery with ANC on.
- It's not meant for workouts. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one)

**Best at the top of the budget: Soundcore Space One Pro, $199.99 ($160 with code AFSC20)**
- It has Adaptive ANC with 6 mics, a fold-flat design, and 8 hours of playback from a 5-minute charge.
- Tom's Guide lists it as its best under $200, noting soft ear cups. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro)

**Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus**
- It has a smooth, bassy tuning, a parametric EQ in the app, and 56 hours of battery.
- Its ANC is weaker than the Soundcore Q45's, and the headband is thinly padded. [RTINGS page with price links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best for calls: Sony ULT WEAR, about $200**
- SoundGuys measured the strongest low-frequency noise reduction of its four picks (more than 25 dB above 80 Hz). It has multipoint and LDAC. [RatingMobile summary of SoundGuys' picks](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- A cheaper Sony option is the WH-CH730N at about $176–179 in the US. Tom's Guide praises its ANC and battery but thinks the US price is high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

**Cheapest decent option: JLab JBuds Lux ANC, about $80**
- It has up to 40 hours of battery with ANC on. Its ANC is the weakest of the group, enough for a bus or office but not a flight. [Tom's Guide roundup](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)

## Things to know
- **Discount code:** AFSC20 is 20% off full-price items only. Dealectric says it last tested the code on Oct 22, 2026. I couldn't verify it myself, so confirm it at checkout.
- **Affiliate links:** The Soundcore links are affiliate links, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy.
- **Space Q45:** RTINGS' budget pick (around $100) has reports of hinge and headband breakage.
- **Prices:** Prices shift often, and some figures come from March 2026 reviews.

If you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android and mainly travel or work in an office, I can narrow this to one pick.
